record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only the pointwise loss to 1.2*softplus(-positive_score)+softplus(negative_score), retaining the existing mask and reduction. Modestly increasing positive-target weight may improve relevant-item retention without the pairwise auxiliary term that previously regressed. Preserve sampled pairs, embeddings, causal architecture, scoring, readout, optimizer and all training settings. Train one independent model per category.
